messages:
anya-cs: Heads-up — FinBudget just uploaded a bespoke security questionnaire (SIG + CAIQ subset) and needs answers by tomorrow EOD PST. Main asks: KMS/HSM integration details, audit log retention policy, and whether we can export sanitized access logs. They mentioned they hit an API 401 yesterday when trying to pull audit artifacts; they say that blocked their compliance team. Ticket CAB-4823 created. @meera-security can you own the technical answers?

emily-cs: I uploaded the form here: https://redwood.s3/finbudget/questionnaire.pdf. Highlights flagged: 1) key custody (bring-your-own-key?), 2) HSM attestation, 3) retention window (they requested 7 years), 4) proof of audit log exports. Due: 2026-03-18 23:59 PST.

meera-security: thanks. I'll draft recommended language. Quick Q: do they want KMS key material to be customer-managed (BYOK) or just evidence of HSM usage? emily-cs: they said "customer-managed preferred" in the notes.

david-se: FinBudget pasted an excerpt of the failed request in the ticket, here's the error we saw in logs:

```
2026-03-16T14:12:03Z ERROR auth: token validation failed: invalid_jwt (exp claim in the past)
request_id=8f3a2c
endpoint=/audit/export
response_code=401
```

They used SDK v1.2.1. Could be token refresh race. Need to repro — @ryan-eng can you look at SDK refresh flow?

ryan-eng: jumping in. v1.2.1 had a refresh race when long-running export jobs hit expiry > 30s mid-stream. Quick repro steps: 1) generate short-lived key (60s), 2) start export via /audit/export, 3) sleep 65s while stream active -> 401. Workaround: upgrade to SDK v1.2.3 or set token TTL >= 5m. I can prepare a short note for the customer. :thumbsup:

meera-security: For the questionnaire, suggested answers (short form):
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). For higher-assurance workflows we provide an HSM-backed key option — we can provide attestation metadata (certified FIPS 140-2 Level 3 where applicable).
- Key export: Private key material is never exportable from our HSM-managed environments; customers can use BYOK to retain exclusive control.
- Audit logs: We retain immutable audit logs for 365 days by default; extended retention (up to 7 years) is available as an enterprise add-on. Exports are available in CSV/NDJSON and we can provide sanitized samples upon NDA.
- Incident/prior breaches: We have no incidents in the last 24 months.

I can paste a copy-paste block for the questionnaire. Also recommend we provide a sanitized audit export to show format — need eng to run export and then security to scrub PII.

jordan-legal: Please ensure any sample logs redact IPs and user identifiers. Also confirm we can share the attestation PDFs (some are third-party-owned). If sharing, we need a Data Processing Addendum and the mutual NDA flag. I'll prepare a short sharing checklist.

ticket-bot: Support case CAB-4823 updated: priority=P1 -> escalated to security + engineering. Owner assigned: anya-cs.

anya-cs: I'll coordinate. Plan: (1) @ryan-eng produce sanitized export and repro notes by EOD today, (2) @meera-security draft questionnaire responses and provide paste-ready text, (3) @jordan-legal confirm NDA/sharing checklist. I'll send the completed packet to FinBudget tomorrow morning and call their compliance lead. Any blockers? :eyes:

emily-cs: I'll notify FinBudget about the SDK workaround and that we're compiling the package.

ryan-eng: I'll run the export job now, will sanitize and drop into the ticket with repro commands. Repro command I'll include:
```
# reproduce 401
TOKEN_TTL=60 ./redwood-export --project finbudget --since 2026-03-01 --format ndjson
sleep 65
# expect 401 during stream
```

Expect a sanitized sample in CAB-4823 in ~2h.

meera-security: Draft ready, I'll paste suggested answers into CAB-4823 and attach the attestation references.

anya-cs: Perfect. Thanks everyone — please add any final notes in the ticket. I'll mark the thread as closed once packet sent.
